ModMetaData.name: Black Swarmling Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Replaces sarg.alphaanimals's VFEI2_BlackSwarmling art (south/east/north facings only) with a render generated for this campaign. LABEL/ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path (Things/Pawn/Animal/VFEI2_BlackSwarmling/VFEI2_BlackSwarmling_<facing>) the donor uses so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
